h2. Description

*Asset rows print the unit number immediately against the year, with no space or separator*, so the
two run together into one unreadable word.

For example, when an Asset result is returned:

* A vehicle with unit *TRK 412*, a *2019 Freightliner Cascadia*, reads *"TRK 4122019 Freightliner Cascadia"*.
* A vehicle with unit *BSH 001*, a *2025 Freightliner M2*, reads *"BSH 0012025 Freightliner M2"*.
* A vehicle with *no* unit number reads correctly - *"2021 KEN WORTH T680"*.
* Every asset that has a unit number is affected, seeded or not.

The unit number and the year/make/model are two separate facts and must read as two. The work-order
row already separates them correctly with a middle dot - *"TRK 412 · 2019 Freightliner Cascadia"* -
so the two row types disagree with each other on the same screen.

This appears inconsistent with the expected *Asset result row* defined in *Epic SV-9160* and
*Global Search - Product Requirements v1.5*.

h2. Steps to Reproduce

# Sign in to ShopView and open *Global Search* using the Search control in the top-right corner, or press *Ctrl + K*.
# Search for {{Fib}}.
# Scroll to the *Assets* section and read the main line of each row:
#* *2021 KEN WORTH T680* - correct; this vehicle has no unit number.
#* *TRK 4122019 Freightliner Cascadia* - unit {{TRK 412}} joined to the year {{2019}}.
#* *TRK 4162024 INTERNATIONAL LT625*, *TRK 4152023 MACK ANTHEM*, *TRK 4142020 VOLVO VNL760* - the same.
# For comparison, look at any *Work orders* row: the second line reads *TRK 412 · 2019 Freightliner Cascadia*, correctly separated.

*Actual Result:*
On every asset that has a unit number, the unit and the year are printed with nothing between them,
producing a run-together token such as *TRK 4122019* that reads as a single meaningless number.

*Expected Result:*
The unit number is separated from the year/make/model, in the same style the work-order row already
uses - for example *TRK 412 · 2019 Freightliner Cascadia*.

h2. Screenshots

!asset-row.png|width=684!

_Searching "Fib". The first vehicle has no unit number and reads correctly; every vehicle below it
has a unit number joined to its year._

----

*Environment:* the new search on the test branch [https://sv9160.qa.shopview.com|https://sv9160.qa.shopview.com/]
(build {{v26.36.7-29ca209}}), signed in as an administrator, observed 17 September 2026. The vehicles
used are the seeded {{ZZAUTOTEST Fibridge}} fleet and {{ZZAUTOTEST Bryan Smith Hauling}}'s 2025
Freightliner M2, all on the branch now.

h2. Sources

{quote}An Asset result shows year, make and model as the main line (for example "2025 Freightliner
M2"). The owning customer name is shown as smaller secondary text. A vehicle icon is shown on the
left of the row.{quote}

{quote}A Work Order result row ... the second line shows the unit number and the year/make/model
(for example "TRK 412 · 2019 Freightliner Cascadia").{quote}

Global Search - Product Requirements, version 1.5 - Confluence page 576978945.
